latest.title: Troubleshooting Lambda Durable Functions with AWS DevOps Agent
latest.description: Learn how to use AWS DevOps Agent to autonomously investigate failures in Lambda durable function workflows. This article demonstrates how DevOps Agent correlates CloudTrail events, CloudWatch logs, metrics, and X-Ray traces to identify root causes that span multiple functions and callback suspension boundaries. Includes real investigation scenarios and effective prompting strategies.

latest.title: How AWS CloudWatch Monitors Your Cloud in Real Time
latest.description: CloudWatch is more than dashboards. Learn how metrics, logs, alarms, and anomaly detection work together to catch AWS failures before your users do.

latest.title: Why I Moved from DCGAN to WGAN-GP: Building More Stable GAN Training
latest.description: GANs look elegant in theory, but training them in practice is far more challenging. While training a DCGAN on ~70k face images, I faced unstable optimization, long training cycles, and Colab interruptions. That experience pushed me to explore WGAN and WGAN-GP more deeply.

latest.title: Como Aprender Qualquer Linguagem de Programação de Forma Autodidata
latest.description:
Muita gente entra na programação achando que precisa decorar códigos, copiar projetos prontos ou aprender dezenas de linguagens ao mesmo tempo. Mas a verdade é que programar não começa pela linguagem. Começa pela lógica.

E é exatamente por isso que muita gente desiste cedo: tentam aprender “código” sem antes aprender a pensar como programador.

latest.title: アクセスキーが流出した時、何をしなければならないか再考してみる
latest.description: AWSから届く「Unexpected Activity Detected」通知の各ステップを読み解き、アクセスキーの無効化・ローテーション、CloudTrailによるIAMリソースの不正操作の追跡、全リージョンでの意図しないリソース作成の確認、請求調整申請までの一連の対処フローを実践的に解説します。

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
